description: This Java source file defines the KeywordIndex class responsible for indexing product-related data for keyword search functionality within the OFBiz framework. It gathers various product attributes, related entities, and content resources to generate a searchable keyword index, including mechanisms for weighting and filtering keywords.

classes.name: KeywordIndex
classes.description: Provides methods for indexing product data into a keyword search index, including handling of product attributes, features, contents, and related entities with support for weighting and content processing.

methods.name: forceIndexKeywords
methods.description: Force reindexing of keywords for the given product by calling indexKeywords with doAll=true.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Main method to index keywords for a product, with optional full reindexing based on the doAll flag. Collects and processes product attributes, features, related content, and associations to prepare a weighted keyword list, then stores it in the database.

methods.name: addWeightedDataResourceString
methods.description: Retrieves text content from a data resource and adds it to the keyword list multiple times based on the specified weight.

methods.name: addWeightedKeywordSourceString
methods.description: Adds a product attribute or related entity's string value to the keyword list with optional weighting.
